title: dm+d manifest reply
description: 200 reply of GET /api/v1/pharmacy/dmd/latest, written by the portal from the field table and sample of PORTAL-CHANGES-pharmacy.md item 12 (till 0.1.85 pack; EPOS sent no schema). Unknown members are ignored by the till; more may be added.

week.description: ISO week of releaseDate. Shown / logged only.

archiveFileName.description: NHSBSA's own zip name, unchanged (the same name TRUD lists).

downloadUrl.description: https, or relative to the portal address. On another host it must be pre-signed for at least 24 hours; the till sends no headers there.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the zip, 64 hex characters (either case).

publishedAt.description: When the portal published this week (UTC). Shown / logged only.
